thread:
morgan: Quick question  how do we want the sidebar to handle deep-links to items that moved in last week's IA sweep? e.g. old /workspaces/42/models -> now /assets/models. keep old urls or redirect?

tara: Strong preference to preserve public deep-links. Router should resolve aliases and UI should indicate the new location (small "moved" label). Also show a one-time toast on first visit.

devin: Alias mapping is easy to add. Implementation note: router tries exact match -> alias lookup -> resolved route. Concern: breadcrumb/state could show inconsistent path if we don't normalize to new hierarchy.

alex: UX: expand the new group, highlight the item, and update breadcrumb to the new path. Keep the original URL for browser/links (history.replace to the aliased canonical?).

sam: Accessibility: when auto-expanding, move focus to the item and announce via aria-live: "Opened: MyModel (moved to Assets > Models)". Ensure aria-current is set and the moved label is keyboard focusable if it opens a tooltip.

morgan: For animation do we prefer expand -> smooth scroll -> focus, or immediate focus? I vote expand -> smooth scroll -> focus. less jarring.

devin: agree. pseudo: "expandGroup(); requestAnimationFrame(() => { anchor.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); anchor.focus({preventScroll:true}); });"

tara: Toast copy suggestion: "Moved: This item now lives in Assets > Models. We'll keep this link working for you. [Learn more]" Dismissible, one-shot per org.

alex: Track metrics: percent of deep-links resolved by alias, tooltip clicks, 404 count for two weeks after rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging scheduled: 2024-12-06 02:30 UTC

morgan: Cool. I'll open a spec PR with alias format + a11y checklist + visuals. Assigning tasks now.

tara: follow-up: internal admin links? prefer a migration warning instead of silent breaking.

alex: agreed  provide admins a migration map and an org-level toggle to enable legacy paths while they update bookmarks.
